name: SimplePost
description: SimplePost helps users work with their connected social media accounts directly from Claude: list accounts, upload media, validate drafts, preview posts across platforms, publish or schedule posts, save and manage drafts, and open an interactive day, week, or month schedule showing slots and post activity.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SimplePost to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SimplePost to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.simplepost.social/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SimplePost MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SimplePost provides these MCP tools: create_post, discard_scheduled_post, inspect_posts, list_accounts, preview_post, update_scheduled_post, upload_media, and validate_post.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SimplePost?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SimplePost in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SimplePost requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SimplePost is developed by Creafex Lab Vladimir Haltakov. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
